blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The Filipino Counterpart Requirement is a frequently tested concept. Foreign architects CANNOT practice independently in the Philippines — they must always work in association with a local Philippine architect, partnership, or corporation. The Filipino counterpart assumes local regulatory responsibility and compliance.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Tip>Joint ventures are project-specific and dissolve upon completion. Unlike partnerships, dissolution does not affect each architect's individual professional status. Participants may recombine with different partners on subsequent projects — this flexibility is a key advantage over permanent partnership structures.</Tip>
